notes:
Cleaner reading on every art style.

• Words the text reader mangled into numbers are repaired before they're spoken — no more "b zero zero y" where the page says "body".
• Real numbers still read as numbers: chapters, years, times, "7th-gen".
• Scribbles picked up off the artwork are no longer read out mid-scene.

Tested across six titles from two sources, from tall webtoon strips to double-page manga spreads.
